name: Sodium-ion batteries
principle: Sodium replaces lithium in the cathode and electrolyte chemistry, avoiding lithium and cobalt. CATL launched its Naxtra sodium-ion line in April 2025 at 175 Wh/kg; HiNa products run 140 to 155 Wh/kg.
